result.summary: The home screen is largely intact, but there are visual defects: an empty profile placeholder in the header and truncated carousel/list cards cut off at the viewport edges.

issues.description: Top-right circular button appears empty/broken - light grey circle with only a small red notification dot and no avatar, profile icon, or initial inside.
issues.suggestion: Render a default profile icon or user initial with proper fallback; ensure avatar image loads and notification dot is positioned on a visible icon.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' with image and '0 delivery info' cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Preserve horizontal peek affordance but add proper end padding, snap behavior and ellipsis for truncated titles so text does not appear broken.

issues.description: Second card in 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom - only partial pizza image with -20% badge and favorite heart are visible, with no restaurant name, delivery time or rating visible above the bottom tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom list padding so cards are not clipped by the fixed tab bar and ensure each card's image plus metadata block scrolls fully into view.
